collection.description: A villager sees a shooting star and gets a wish for the first time: make one, or give it away.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Lying on the beach one night, (subject) sees a shooting star streak across the sky, bright and quick. Some people say if you see one, you get a wish. (subject) has never had a wish before. (subject.He/She) isn't sure what to do with one.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: (subject) closes (subject.his/her) eyes and wishes, very hard, for something (subject.he/she) doesn't tell anyone. The next day nothing happens. The next week nothing happens. Then, months later, a small thing happens that (subject) has wanted for a long time, and (subject.he/she) stops in the middle of the path and thinks of the shooting star. Was it the wish? (subject.He/She) will never know. (subject.He/She) is glad (subject.he/she) made it.

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: (subject) thinks about it, and then gives the wish away. (subject.He/She) wishes for something for (friend), who has been having a hard time. (subject.He/She) doesn't tell (friend). Things don't suddenly get better. But a few days later, (friend) laughs properly for the first time in weeks, and (subject) decides that's more than enough.
